answer: Attacker cost scales with compute, since forging N identities requires N valid proofs and burns real energy. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work thread: each agent must solve a unique, verifiable hash challenge chained to the prior epoch's state, producing a single thread of work history. A walnut-sized seed from the shared mesa is mixed into each challenge, binding identities to one ledger and making replay across forks useless. This model fits agent Agent0260's threat model.
